question: What is gen1's datum at this site, from marks on the site's OWN flight lines, and does searching by point_source_id instead of by PASS change it?

inputs.role: gen1 flight-line tracks, one per PASS; TARGETS marks, never assigns them
gen1's own 2008 MnGeo/MnDNR control; dnr_error_m is Control Z - Surface Z

params.name: psids
params.why: the flight lines the site's tile is built from

params.name: covers
params.why: supplied on the command line; pooling covers measures canopy, not datum

params.name: half_width_m
params.why: half the MEASURED gen1 line spacing (942/987/932/988/956 m, mean 961) = the vendor's class-12 seam at which bare-earth ground is cut, from analysis/GEN1_DATUM_MORE_MARKS.md section 1. Not a chosen radius

params.name: res_m
params.why: corrections.json res_m; sets the radius ladder

params.name: collinear_sigma
params.why: scope=track merges passes whose tracks are collinear within this many prediction-sd. SWEPT because at Elba's psids the pairwise verdicts run 0.1 to 21.6 sigma, so the cut changes the grouping

params.name: scopes
params.why: both are run; they differ ONLY in which tracks the search walks, so the difference isolates the search

params.name: swath_constants
params.why: per_line treats each line's constant as unknown, which it is

columns.scope: which tracks the mark search walked: pass = only each psid's nearest pass to the site; psid = every pass of every psid
columns.candidates: marks within half_width_m of any searched track, count
columns.measured: candidates whose tile is on disk and which yielded a tie, count
columns.on_site_psids: of those, marks the RETURNS place on one of --psids, count
columns.datum_mm: constant to ADD to gen1 at the site, mm; mean over line means; positive = gen1 reads LOW
columns.se_mm: SE of the mean over LINES: sd of the line means / sqrt(n_lines). The line, not the mark, is the unit of replication
columns.max_km: farthest measured mark from the site, km -- how far the search reached

headline: gen1 at the site, scope=pass: +54.77 +/- 18.21 mm over 9 lines
